# Osmograph

> Open desktop software for digital smell: flash firmware, record gas-sensor traces
> from supported e-nose hardware, build drift-corrected change detectors, and manage a
> fleet — no code required.

## Docs
- [README](./README.md): what Osmograph is and how to run it.
- [NOTICE](./NOTICE.md): third-party dataset attribution and link-vs-rehost policy.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): build/test commands and conventions for agents.

## Authoring Vials (extensions)
- [Vial manifest schema](https://opensmell.org/schema/vial.schema.json)
- `noses create <name>` → `noses test` → `noses lint` → `noses publish`
